name: Spherical five-bar pointer plus an active arm roll
verdict: not worth a GPU sweep: best gap 89.13 vs the champion 3R 68.93 (Bench(60,160), march, K2 dense, K6); the skin-aware prefilter over ~17 000 configurations shows the same reach-vs-proximity front, worse than the 3R's (4 rigid arcs + 2 elbows over the cap instead of 2 arcs + 1 elbow)
note: best sweep entry k=13 {'u1az': 94.73248043278903, 'u1el': 83.69955944451229, 'u2az': 94.73248043278903, 'u2el': 83.69955944451229, 'coax': True, 'a1': 75.0, 'a2': 90.0, 'c1': 60.0, 'c2': 45.0, 'wd': 90, 'wa': 0, 's1': -1, 's2': -1, 'margin': 5.0, 'par': 8.0, 'sep': 17.0, 'wc': 10.0, 'q': 1.0}; leg margin 5 deg / parallel 8 deg (at the spec's 8 / 12: gap 90.30, k=6); honest flag false only for coupler 2 sampled at 4.03 mm (kit layout at r_ref 70, coupler at 141 mm; threshold 4.0) - it is 0 % in band, denser sampling only lowers in-band; elbows are P14 pins (declared hubless); mass 231 g Ti
limiter: couplers and elbow pins ride high: coupler 1 level 82-137 mm, coupler 2 99-141 mm, pin B1 129 mm, pin B2 99 mm (0-1 % in band) because the elbows climb over the cap when the arm goes overhead and every rigid arc must clear the highest skin it ever passes over; reach lost overhead (ws taken 0.38 at elevation 100-140, 0.17 above 140) to leg singularities (32/160 ws poses), parallel singularity (9), collisions (15)
audit: coupler2: sparse sampling (4.03 mm median spacing > 4 mm)
audit_verdict: death stands (auditor reproduced gap 89.13 on Bench(60,160), march, K2 dense, K6): even with the part-part stacking (over) and K6 both switched off - physically impossible - the best config only reaches 66.64; the honest stacking of 4 rigid arcs + 2 elbow pins over the cap (pins 99/129 mm, couplers 0 % in band) is the limiter, not a bug

mechanism.notes: spherical five-bar + active roll, best config coaxial (one double-row base hub). bodies: crank 1, crank 2, coupler 1, coupler 2, arm-end plate + neck. joints: A1, A2 (active, base), B1, B2 elbow pins (passive, MR126), C couplers at W (passive), D roll at W (active). 1 loop (the 5R). Passives B1, B2, C set by closure; A1, A2, D read the arm (two-cone FK), so none is sensed. custom: base hub housing, 2 cranks, 2 couplers, arm plate + neck, 4 shafts (est.); catalogue: 4 + 4 bearings in the two double-row hubs, 2 MR126 (est.).
